mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_dislike_novel (user_id, novel_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{novelId})
INSERT IGNORE INTO user_dislike_author (user_id, author_name) VALUES (#{userId}, #{authorName})
INSERT IGNORE INTO user_dislike_tag (user_id, tag_name) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tagName})
mapper.select: SELECT novel_id FROM user_dislike_novel WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT author_name FROM user_dislike_author WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT tag_name FROM user_dislike_tag WHERE user_id = #{userId}
